crossRefs.note: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.

translations.web: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
translations.bsb: Even as the fool walks along the road, his sense is lacking, and he shows everyone that he is a fool.
translations.kjv: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
translations.asv: Yea also, when the fool walketh by the way, his understanding faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
